definitions.ask: Should references that arrive while the Refs panel is open join the visible list on their own?
definitions.why: The pain is an open panel that never shows the new ref; selection stays id-based

choices.label: New refs appear in the open panel within seconds; rows below an arrival may shift down one
Rows never move while open; a footer 'N new · ⌘R' hint shows until you press ⌘R or reopen

definitions.ask: Should athena and apollo drain their xlib/ intake queue every 2 minutes instead of every 10?
definitions.why: An empty queue takes no lock and does no sync, so the faster cadence costs almost nothing

choices.label: Queued creates reach the Mac within ~2 min; one extra no-op bob spawn per host every 2 min
The rare create that falls back to the queue can still wait up to 10 minutes
